purpose: Audit whether the existing Promotion Contract contains a pre-registered, executable PASS criterion for fold/LOFO stability. This artifact does not create a new performance threshold and does not alter the Promotion Contract.

checks.detail: Promotion Contract v1 explicitly requires fixed LOFO and top-fold exclusion stress.
Promotion Contract v1 does not specify a numeric or otherwise executable pre-registered PASS criterion for acceptable fold concentration/LOFO stability.
No new threshold or acceptance rule is introduced after observing the evidence.
Previously computed LOFO and top-fold stress remain descriptive evidence only.

verdict.reason: The current contract requires fold/LOFO stability but does not contain an executable pre-registered acceptance criterion. Inventing one now would be post-hoc tuning. Therefore this audit intentionally leaves G5 blocked.

next_allowed_action: A separately versioned, pre-registered amendment may define an acceptance criterion only before any new G5 decision is made; until then G5 remains blocking.
